narrative.synopsis: Demeter’s grief enters a mortal house at Eleusis. Her hidden attempt to make Demophon immortal fails when Metaneira interrupts, but the failure becomes the origin of Eleusinian honor for the goddess.
narrative.openingSituation: Demeter is wandering in disguise, withdrawn from Olympus and from the harvest.
narrative.centralConflict: A mortal mother’s fear interrupts a divine attempt to change a child’s fate.
narrative.resolution: Demeter reveals herself and commands worship.
narrative.outcome: Eleusis becomes bound to Demeter’s mysteries and favor.

events.consequence: Demeter comes to Eleusis in disguise.
She places him in fire to make him deathless.
Metaneira cries out and stops the rite.
